mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install trim and molding in an average room?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required for trim and molding installation varies significantly based on the room size, the complexity of the trim profile, and the amount of preparation needed. For a standard room with basic baseboards and door casings, it might take one to two days. However, a room with multiple windows, doors, and intricate crown molding or paneling could take several days to a week for precise fitting and finishing. We provide detailed estimates during our consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time depends on room size, trim complexity, and preparation. A basic room might take 1-2 days, while intricate designs could take several days to a week.
